Grooming

What the salon offers

From the photos, the Instagram profile and what owners write in their Google reviews.

Bath and haircut

Grooming and bath for dogs of all kinds. One owner writes that matted fur was gently untangled before the haircut.

Big dogs too

Owners of German Shepherds write that their dogs stay calm here. One praises the experience with bigger breeds.

Booking ahead

Appointments are arranged by message. Owners advise booking in advance, because the salon is always busy.

How owners describe a visit

Taken from what owners write in their Google reviews.

Love for animals

6 Google reviews mention the love for animals, 5 the caring staff.

Calm dogs

One owner writes that her anxious dog now feels safe, calm and happy and is excited for her bath.

Little extras

Owners mention treats, cute accessories after each visit and small gifts at Christmas.

On Larisis

At Larisis 25 in Larnaca, inside The Pet Club. Open Monday to Friday 10:00-17:00, Saturday 9:00-15:00, Sunday closed. Phone 94 093813.
